crime_method: Police-reported jurisdiction-level Crime Severity Index, not a neighbourhood or school safety rating. Surrey service transition prevents a like-for-like combined comparison. No indices averaged.
route_method: BC address geocoder coordinates; OSRM/OpenStreetMap network routes where returned successfully. Router times are model estimates, not observed trips, live traffic, accessibility audits or confirmed public access. Parcel points and block/intersection destinations can snap to another street or side of a park. Walking ranges use distance at 3–4.5 km/h, with 2–5 minutes access allowance. When routing failed, a separate rough range uses straight-line distance times 1.3–1.8, not a measured route.
